title: POST /check-url has no direct tests for its classification branches
reasoning: The route has distinct behavior for blank input, YouTube URLs, fetched feeds with audio enclosures, fetch failures, and default article classification, but the associated test file only covers list/create/sync endpoints. That leaves the route's public response contract and network-adjacent edge cases unguarded.
recommendation: Add focused route tests for youtube, podcast, article, fetch failure/default, and malformed or misleading URL inputs. Mock ContentProcessor.parse_feed so the tests are deterministic and do not perform network I/O.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No test in tests/test_feeds.py posts to /api/feeds/check-url or asserts feed_type values.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests that post to /api/feeds/check-url with a YouTube channel URL, a mocked podcast feed, a mocked article feed, and a non-YouTube URL containing a YouTube substring.
minimumFixScope: Add POST /check-url coverage in tests/test_feeds.py or a dedicated check-url test module.
